title: Participant actions and custom-template internals
subtitle: 2 / 2  Participants start and verify in Azure Portal | Azure provisions, initializes, and validates resources
footer: Source review: 2026-09-19 | Gray: operation order; purple: dependencies. Logical flow, not fully serial provisioning. Live Azure success unverified.
notes:
Separate participant Azure Portal operations from custom-template internal processing.
Participants manually create a dedicated RG, load azuredeploy.json, select Subscription and the existing RG, retain released defaults, and choose Create. Verify overall Succeeded and workshopContext.setup_status=complete. Participants do not run initialization CLI or Python on their PC.
Infrastructure, connections, and RBAC follow Bicep dependencies, not a single serial chain. Foundry project, primary, evaluation, and embedding PUTs are serialized. Deployment Scripts starts after required models, Search, connections, and RBAC, using a dedicated UAMI. It downloads an immutable sourceRevision archive and prepares isolated Python. After manifest/schema/checksum checks, bootstrap_custom_template.py runs Search policy, Search approval, prepare-evaluation, and validate-environment in order.
bootstrap_data.py generates embeddings via an OpenAI client and uploads them to Search. run_evaluation.py --prepare-only registers two datasets and a rubric; it does not execute evaluation or optimization jobs. Validation checks context, key resources, participant Foundry User role, API health, and Search schema/counts, not every participant operation. Only full success writes status complete to AZ_SCRIPTS_OUTPUT_PATH. Intermediate failures do not publish completion and fail deployment. Temporary ACI/Storage is removed on success, retained one day on failure, with a one-hour runtime limit. Keep the bootstrap UAMI until RG deletion.
Sources: labs/01-setup.md; infra/main.bicep; scripts/bootstrap-custom-template.sh; scripts/bootstrap_custom_template.py; scripts/bootstrap_data.py; scripts/run_evaluation.py; scripts/validate_environment.py. The original source comparison predates this English edition and is not live-deployment evidence. English source and API publication remain separate release prerequisites.
